system.description:
You spin your weapon fast enough to ignite the very air before stabbing forwards, looking to strike your foe with the fury of the sun. Make a melee Taijutsu attack against a creature in range. On a hit your deal your weapons damage +4d8 Fire damage and on hit.

All hostile creatures of your choice, excluding the original target, in a 15-foot cone originating from the target creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking half the Fire damage rolled on a failure and none on a success.

Chain 2: After striking you retain some of the kinetic heat on your weapon. You weapon deals +2d6 Fire damage the next time you deal damage with it before the end of your next turn, after which, the heat dissipates.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
